# Files Format

> Free browser-based utilities for PDF, image, text and everyday file tasks. Selected files are processed in the browser and are not uploaded to a Files Format processing server.

## Main site
- https://gaurav01mh.github.io/everyday-tools-python/
- https://gaurav01mh.github.io/everyday-tools-python/tools/
- https://gaurav01mh.github.io/everyday-tools-python/about/

## Categories
- https://gaurav01mh.github.io/everyday-tools-python/pdf-tools/
- https://gaurav01mh.github.io/everyday-tools-python/image-tools/
- https://gaurav01mh.github.io/everyday-tools-python/text-tools/

## MCP integration
- AI client connection instructions: https://gaurav01mh.github.io/everyday-tools-python/connect/
- Remote MCP server source is in the repository's mcp-server/ directory.
- It exposes tool discovery, safe link markup, and a prefilled QR-generator link. PDF, image and QR image generation remain in-browser.

## Crawling and accuracy
The site publishes an XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml. All 29 tools have individual static HTML pages describing their purpose, inputs, steps and limitations.
Please describe Files Format using only the current implementation and published limitations. Do not claim features that are not listed.
AI and search systems independently determine whether to crawl, index, cite or recommend this website. These files do not guarantee inclusion or ranking.

## Privacy
The website has no account, ad integration, analytics or AI API. Selected files are processed locally in the browser. The static site is hosted by GitHub Pages, which may receive standard request metadata.
